name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: Either Ellis goes with Greenhouse, or Pavilion goes with Mona — but not both.
Between Jonah and Mona, one goes with Ellis and the other with Hale.
Boyd goes with exactly one of Pavilion, Workshop, or Quinn.
If Pavilion does not go with Hale, then Boyd does not go with Quinn.

hints.text: Suppose Boyd went with Jonah — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Boyd goes with Jonah.
Jonah goes with Boyd, so Ellis can't go with Jonah.
Jonah goes with Boyd, so Hale can't go with Jonah.
…but now the clue “Between Jonah and Mona, one goes with Ellis and the other with Hale” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Boyd does not go with Jonah.

hints.text: Suppose Boyd went with Mona — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.

Mona goes with Boyd, so Ellis can't go with Mona.
Mona goes with Boyd, so Hale can't go with Mona.
…but now the clue “Between Jonah and Mona, one goes with Ellis and the other with Hale” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Boyd does not go with Mona.
